messages:
Carmen: Quick sync - dropping a succinct RN draft. Need confirmation to pin model-server v2.3.1 and schedule a short stage-gate at 16:20 PT. Can owners ack?
Dinesh: Reading now. Draft looks good. Please pin as `v2.3.1-rn-2024-06` so its explicit for canary rules.
Alex: I can own the pin + deploybot trigger. Tiny ask: shift to 16:25 PT? timezone on my side.
Carmen: 16:25 OK. Add a rollback note: roll back to v2.3.0 and flip feature-flag "long_ctx_v2" off if errors.
Lena: +1 rollback. Suggest rollout cadence: canary 5% for 8 minutes, 20% for 10 minutes, then full. Also recommend extra KV-cache warmup step.
SRE Oncall: Allocated 16:20-17:00 for change window. I'll watch latency and 5xx. Set automated alert: 5xx >= 1% for 3m => incident channel.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: job 84912 | env=prod-dedicated | image=model-server:v2.3.1 | strategy=canary(5%,8m)->20%(10m)->100% | requested_by=Alex | pin_label=v2.3.1-rn-2024-06
Alex: Dry-run plan: `deploybot trigger 84912 --dry-run` at 16:15 PT, timed rollout at 16:25 if green. Ill post internal announce after dry-run.
Dinesh: RN blurb suggestion: "Resolves long-context tail latency; note tokenization edge-case that may cause minor variance. Reverts automatically possible via rollback flag." Keep short.
Carmen: Updated RN and added "how to rollback" snippet and alert thresholds. Preview: https://redwood.internal/rn/1719009999 (internal)
Lena: PR looks fine. Whos on hotfix standby if rollback is messy? @SRE Oncall + @Alex?
SRE Oncall: Affirmative. SRE + Alex on standby. Ill open #incident-deploy if threshold hits.
Alex: I'll post the internal announce at 16:18 once dry-run passes. Draft announce: "Rolling model-server v2.3.1 on prod at 16:25 PT. Canary rollout. Standby: @SRE Oncall @Alex @Dinesh."
Carmen: Please pin the RN in #eng-releases after announce and update CHANGELOG with pin label. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: job 84912 status: dry-run passed at 16:16. Ready for scheduled rollout at 16:25.
Alex: Starting timed rollout now.
deploy-bot: job 84912 status: canary(5%) started at 16:25.
Lena: Watching metrics - first 3m fine. KV-cache warming completed.
deploy-bot: job 84912 status: canary(20%) started at 16:34.
SRE Oncall: No spike on 5xx, p95 latency stable. Proceed to 100% in 10m unless objections.
Alex: Proceeding to 100%.
deploy-bot: job 84912 status: 100% started at 16:46.
deploy-bot: job 84912 status: success at 16:50.
Carmen: Great work. RN is finalized and pinned; changelog updated. Ill close this thread after posting the internal note.
Dinesh: Thanks team. Closing.
